chunks: It is We who give life and We who give death, and We are the One who will abide.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God is the 'Inheritor' (Al-Warith) in Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Hijr, this verse serves as a rhetorical counter to the disbelievers' claim that they would be resurrected in a new creation, affirming that the One who initiated life is fully capable of reviving it. Shia exegesis emphasizes 'Al-Warithun' (The Inheritor) not merely as a temporal successor but as the Eternal Reality that remains when all contingent beings cease, underscoring God's absolute sovereignty over existence and non-existence.
